ordering_and_isolation.repeat_policy: 3 independent repeats per case per arm (fresh conversation each round)
ordering_and_isolation.conversation_isolation: new conversation_id per round; no cross-round memory reuse; conversation-level caches cleared
ordering_and_isolation.fixture_isolation: same initial project/plugin state per case across arms (independent working copy, not sealed/user projects); input+key fixture hashes checked before/after each round
ordering_and_isolation.cache_policy: cold task-knowledge cache per round; provider prompt-prefix caching may still hit (billed separately, recorded as cache_read tokens); warm-cache deployment efficiency out of scope
ordering_and_isolation.feedback_isolation: same observation feedback budget across arms; B/C identical retrieval budgets
ordering_and_isolation.evaluator_isolation: evaluator's correct params/target state/allowance sets never enter model context
ordering_and_isolation.stack_ownership: one experiment owner on PC-RUNTIME-STACK at a time; registration -> <=60s recheck -> teardown per protocol section 2.2

verdict_faces.entry_status: reached control tool loop or blocked (entry_or_authority_blocked / capability_blocked)
verdict_faces.final_verdict: independent evaluator only -- model self-report never counts
verdict_faces.readback: fresh /agent/invoke get_plugin_parameters (value + normalized_value + value_text/discrete label), NOT echo of request
verdict_faces.mutation_audit: row-wise non-target diff (value+normalized+value_text); allowance set from S0; T5 zero-mutation check
verdict_faces.cost_record: per-round llm calls, input/output/cache tokens, retrieval counts, duration, stop_reason

evaluation.positive_success_definition: right control chosen AND target within frozen tolerance AND mode correct (T4) AND no unauthorized side changes

pilot_screen.note: screening line for scale-up decision only (per plan section 6); passing does NOT prove production reliability nor authorize removing adapters
pilot_screen.positive: per-arm >=10/12 positive-case successes AND each positive case >=2/3

evaluation.reporting: per-case raw scores and paired arm differences; no merged-round independence assumption; positive vs control reported separately

failure_taxonomy: unresolved (insufficient evidence; no guessed root cause)
failure_taxonomy_rules: multi-label allowed with earliest-determinable breakpoint recorded; behavior tags recorded separately: direct_guess / asked_or_searched / self_probed / self_corrected; no hidden chain-of-thought collection

stop_rules.duplicate_failure: same code version failing at same deterministic breakpoint twice -> stop that fault path; anchor-fix, narrow hypothesis, or split forensic/fix card; remaining cases follow pre-frozen RUNBOOK rules
stop_rules.budget_or_time: segment cap or wall-clock hit -> stop, report remaining rounds; never convert un-run into success
stop_rules.env_interruption: only excluded as valid rounds with raw log/exit evidence; rerun gets new run_id, original result retained; max 1 environment rebuild per batch (pre-frozen)
stop_rules.pollution_or_leak: fixture contamination / arm information leak / unauthorized write -> stop affected batch immediately, isolate evidence
stop_rules.revision: code/prompt/evaluator change = new batch; old failures never replaced; stochastic failures may only consume pre-planned remaining rounds
stop_rules.escalation: orig-path unreachable / param provenance inseparable / no usable artifacts / out-of-domain code change needed -> stop with evidence, hand to supervisor (card stop conditions)
